articles.summary: Freeport Earns Recognition in Six National and Global Rankings mboyle Mon, 10/26/2026 - 07:37 Post Image October 26, 2026 - Freeport is earning recognition on several fronts, securing spots on six national and global lists that highlight the company's performance as an employer, its commitment to innovation and its approach to corporate responsibility. The honors, announced in September and October, include improved rankings on several prominent lists, first-time recognition for supporting women in the workplace and a five-star rating for innovation. “These recognitions are especially meaningful because many of they reflect the strength of our company and the contributions of our employees,” said Pam Masson, Senior Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer. “Several are based on employee feedback, reinforcing the importance of creating a workplace where people feel supported, respected and empowered to grow.” A look at Freeport’s recent recognition: 3BL Media: Best Corporate Citizens 2026 Freeport rose to No. 36 from No. 69 in 2025 and ranked No. 8 in the Materials category. This marks the company's 13th appearance on the list since 2007, reflecting its performance across a broad range of corporate responsibility measures. Business Insider: America's Most Innovative Businesses 2027 Freeport earned the highest distinction, a five-star rating, and was one of only three mining companies recognized. The study evaluated more than 4,000 publicly traded U.S. companies based on innovation reputation, impact and investment. Forbes: World’s Best Employers 2026 Freeport advanced to No. 627 from No. 800 in 2025, earning a place among 900 employers recognized worldwide. The ranking is based on employee recommendations and perceptions gathered through an independent international survey. Freeport was recognized in the Construction, Chemicals and Raw Materials category. Forbes: World’s Top Companies for Women 2026 Freeport made its debut on the list at No. 62, earning recognition for its commitment to supporting and advancing women in the workplace. The ranking draws on feedback from more than 120,000 women in 36 countries. The company was recognized in the Construction, Chemicals and Raw Materials category. Newsweek: America’s Greatest Companies 2026 Freeport was among 650 companies selected from approximately 4,300 evaluated for financial strength, workforce performance, innovation and environmental sustainability. TIME: World’s Best Companies 2026 Freeport climbed to No. 555 from No. 638 in 2025 on TIME's list of 1,000 companies worldwide. The ranking considers employee satisfaction, revenue growth and sustainability transparency.
articles.title: Freeport Earns Recognition in Six National and Global Rankings

articles.summary: Globe-Miami Resilience Fund Targets Flood Mitigation mboyle Thu, 10/29/2026 - 07:52 Post Image October 29, 2026 - The Globe-Miami Resilience Fund is making its first investment, committing approximately $250,000 to support development of a regional flood mitigation plan following devastating flooding last year. The plan is a collaborative effort involving Gila County, the Town of Miami and the City of Globe to identify ways to reduce future flood risks and strengthen the region's long-term resilience. The fund was established for the Globe-Miami community to reinvest the proceeds from a federal tax credit associated with the Miami smelter. Established by Freeport to support Arizona’s Globe-Miami area, the fund is expected to provide nearly $2 million in community investments. No additional funding has been allocated specifically to flood mitigation at this time. “Making communities stronger starts with understanding the people who live there,” said Robin Bradford, Social Performance Manager-Miami. “The Globe-Miami Resilience Fund was created to help turn that understanding into action, supporting projects that address local needs and continuing a legacy of responding to community priorities.” Determining those community priorities can happen through many forms, including resident surveys, stakeholder engagement and broader planning efforts. In the case of this mitigation effort, they stem from a shared experience. In 2025, severe flooding damaged homes, businesses and infrastructure throughout the area, prompting an extensive recovery effort. Following the event, Freeport contributed personnel and equipment to help the local community clear mud and debris from affected neighborhoods. While those efforts focused on immediate response and recovery, the regional flood mitigation plan is intended to help address the risk of future incidents. Funding from Freeport will support the engagement of an experienced public-sector post-wildfire flood mitigation expert, who will work alongside local public works, emergency management personnel and technical specialists to develop a comprehensive, long-term plan. The effort is expected to take at least two years. The resulting plan will include recommended mitigation measures, cost estimates, an education and communications plan, and a funding and financing plan to support future implementation. Local governments will work collaboratively to promote adoption of the plan and pursue funding to implement its recommendations. Bradford said this effort reflects the site’s significant and longstanding ties to the area and its commitment to helping build a better future for its residents. “As a company deeply rooted in the Globe-Miami area, we recognize both our responsibility and our opportunity to help lead solutions for the long term,” Bradford said. “By uniting local leadership, technical expertise, and a shared commitment to recovery, we’re helping turn a significant regional challenge into an opportunity to build a safer, more resilient future for the communities we call home.” Photo: Freeport provided volunteers, equipment and financial assistance to the Globe-Miami area following a 2025 flood.
articles.title: Globe-Miami Resilience Fund Targets Flood Mitigation

articles.summary: Freeport Sponsors Restoration of Arizona’s Liberty Bell Replica mboyle Tue, 10/13/2026 - 07:30 Post Image October 13, 2026 - A piece of Arizona history has new life following a restoration sponsored in part by Freeport in recognition of the nation’s 250th anniversary. Freeport recently was recognized as being a sponsor of the restoration of a Liberty Bell replica that has stood outside the historic state Capitol for more than 75 years. The restored bell was rededicated during a recent ceremony in Phoenix. Originally dedicated in 1950, the bell became a centerpiece of Arizona’s statewide efforts commemorating the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence. Freeport was among the sponsors that partnered with the Arizona America 250 Commission on the restoration. As part of the commemoration, the Liberty Bell replica traveled to all 15 Arizona counties as the centerpiece of a mobile museum featuring historic exhibits on Arizona and U.S. history. It then returned to the state Capitol for the dedication ceremony. Freeport’s connection to the bell, however, goes back much further. Phelps Dodge Corp. and Miami Copper Co., both later acquired by Freeport, were among the original sponsors that funded the bell in 1950. Arizona’s bell was one of 53 replicas delivered to states and territories as part of a U.S. Savings Bond drive. The bells were modeled after the original Liberty Bell at Independence Hall in Philadelphia.
articles.title: Freeport Sponsors Restoration of Arizona’s Liberty Bell Replica
